jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Smart Content AI
jobs.description: As the first MLE in the team you will lay the technical foundations for our ML stack, set coding and experimentation standards, and deliver high‑impact models that power content discovery and personalisation across Canva. Build multimodal content‑understanding pipelines that detect people, objects, styles and scenes, turning every asset into richly tagged, high‑quality embeddings. Design similarity search, grouping and organisation services at massive scale to power smart collections and clutter‑free libraries. Propose innovative AI features and rapidly prototype them, diving into the trickiest system components to validate ideas and unblock the team. Optimise for the right trade‑off—time‑to‑market, cost, quality and latency—scaling solutions from billions of public assets to pixel‑perfect subsets for enterprise brands. You thrive in cross-functional teams and enjoy collaborating with engineers, UX designers, and PMs. You have a product mindset—you optimize for user impact, make pragmatic trade-offs, and communicate clearly with non-technical partners. You love solving real-world challenges by reducing friction and creating smart workflows through the use of AI. The position is remote across ANZ (Australia and New Zealand) and is based at Canva's Sydney office.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Content ML
jobs.description: The team's vision is to empower all users with the safest and highest quality content at scale, building models and human-in-the-loop workflows to amplify content review efforts. The goal is to build an automated review system with humans at the heart of operations, leading the continuous improvement and evolution of the system. Key Responsibilities: The role involves researching, developing and deploying AI-based solutions to automate content moderation and review of Canva's content, working with diverse stakeholders to guide technical vision while being responsible for breakdown and delivery of large projects, designing and developing solutions with hands-on software development, fostering an impactful team through code review culture and knowledge sharing, promoting a safe culture with focus on collaboration and communication, and staying updated on industry trends and best practices. This role is remote-friendly within Australia, so candidates can choose the setup that empowers them and their team to do their best work.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Training & Dataset Platform
jobs.description: You'll build and improve data pipelines, dataset tooling, and platform components that support ML training and evaluation. You'll partner with ML and applied science teams to translate training/evaluation needs into scalable platform solutions. You'll implement quality controls (validation, monitoring, testing) to improve trust in data and pipeline outcomes. You'll debug issues across data + ML workflows, driving root-cause fixes and preventing repeat incidents. You'll support iteration velocity by improving developer experience for dataset discovery, usage, and experimentation. You're comfortable & have demonstrated experience working with large datasets and understand data preprocessing, feature engineering, and evaluation techniques. You have strong programming skills (e.g., Python) and experience with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). In the AI Platform group — AI Capabilities / Dataset & Training Platform — we build the underlying systems that enable teams across Canva to develop and improve AI features at scale. We focus on making high-quality training data easier to create, manage, and evaluate, while keeping trust, safety, and reliability front-and-centre.

jobs.title: AI Research Intern, Summer 2026/2027
jobs.description: Atlassian is offering a PhD Research Intern position on their cutting-edge Machine Learning Research team, focusing on advanced machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, particularly Large language models (LLMs), Generative AI, Conversational Agents, and AI Optimization. The role involves conducting continued training, fine-tuning, and alignment of large language models for specialized applications such as conversational AI, summarization, generative search, and multimodal agents. As a PhD intern, you will gain hands-on experience in both foundational research and practical applications, contributing to the training, evaluation and optimized inferencing of AI models that could be used by millions of customers, while collaborating closely with experienced researchers and engineers. A completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required. Candidates should have expertise in managing data using Python libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, in addition to leveraging models from Hugging Face and practical knowledge of applied machine learning and deep learning frameworks, like PyTorch. This role is located in the Australian Eastern Standard (AEST) time zone, and applications will be accepted from Australian and New Zealand Citizens, Australian Permanent Residents and International Students. The paid program runs for 12 weeks between November 2026 - February 2027.

jobs.title: Data Science Intern, 2026 Summer Australia
jobs.description: The paid internship program runs for 12 weeks between November 2026 - February 2027. You'll report to a manager within the Data Science team where you'll build understanding of data science's value through a structured project, and share recommendations with peers and leadership to drive critical decisions. Key responsibilities include: measure the impact of product strategy; design and analyse experiments and launches; build data-driven recommendations and present insights to peers and leadership to influence decisions; partner across engineering, product, design and analytics to improve customer experiences. Requirements: currently enrolled in a Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in a quantitative discipline (e.g. statistics, mathematics, physics, econometrics, engineering or computer science); have experience manipulating data using one of SQL, R, Python; able to commit to a 12-week full-time (40hrs/week) program from November 2026 - February 2027; completing your studies by January 2028. Applications will be accepted from Australian and New Zealand Citizens and Australian Permanent Residents.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: DroneShield is seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join their growing team in Sydney, Australia. Reporting to the SensorFusionAI (SFAI) Team Lead, you will play a key role in developing multi-sensor AI models that contribute towards sensor fusion or provide real-time actionable intelligence to end users across defence, security and critical infrastructure domains. The role includes: Develop, maintain, finetune and extend existing MLOps pipelines and frameworks; Contribute to the long-term AI/ML roadmap of DroneShield's world-class counter-drone solutions; Collaborate with data engineers to support data collection, ETL and annotation workflows. Requirements: Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience, along with minimum of 3 years of professional, hands-on experience developing, training, and deploying machine learning models, including traditional, deep learning, and attention-based transformer architectures. Additional technical requirements include proficiency in Python; knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g. Go, C++) is favourable, and strong experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end MLOps pipelines, using tools such as ClearML is also required.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: As a Data Scientist, you will drive the enhancement of product data, personalization, and customer experience by building and optimizing data-driven solutions on the Woolworths supermarkets website and app. Key responsibilities include designing and implementing statistical models, conducting A/B testing to evaluate product performance, and leveraging machine learning techniques to optimize operations. A strong understanding of Python, Pandas, SQL, and analytical tools is essential for analyzing large datasets and generating reports that inform strategy. Woolworths' AI & Machine Learning team develop and implement advanced technology solutions to improve the efficiency and productivity of Woolworths operations. Through a partnership with Quantium, a world-class data science and advanced analytics business, Woolworths has created a new business called wiq who will harness the best of both companies to reimagine retail by solving complex problems using data and analytics.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Deep Learning Specialist (Computer Vision)
jobs.description: You will work with an incredibly passionate and talented team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, and your work will have a real impact on Nearmap products. You will train novel deep learning models that leverage our rich data sets, multiple dates of high-resolution imagery, multi-angle source imagery and 3D textured mesh. You will collaborate closely with other team members to solve various 2D and 3D vision tasks by selecting the model architecture, designing training and evaluation methodologies, generating a suitable dataset, and optimising models for deployment. Ability to code in scientific Python, using a Linux environment, and Git for source control. Experience in applying deep learning techniques to commercial use cases and non-academic problems is highly valued. A strong background in 3D modelling is advantageous in this role. This role is based in Sydney, Australia but also open to candidates from the east coast of Australia working remotely. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must have permanent rights to work in Australia.

jobs.title: 2026 Data Science Graduate Program
jobs.description: CommBank is looking for results-driven individuals who are adept problem solvers, solutions-focused, resilient, strategically minded, and proactive. You'll kick-start your learning journey with a bespoke Data Science Essentials Bootcamp & Modelling Project, learn technical skills, tools and approaches to Data Science at the bank, and then work on a real business problem while being coached and mentored by practitioners who are known across the industry for their incredible thought leadership and experience. You can gain exposure in data science, behavioural science, advanced analytics, quantitative & predictive modelling, AI & machine learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), data engineering, and more. After the program you can land a role at CommBank as a Data Scientist, Insights Analytics Analyst, or Data Engineer. CommBank's flexible 12–18-month program offers a tailored experience over 2-3 rotations where they support you in navigating their vast tech ecosystem.

jobs.title: Data Scientist: AI and Machine Learning
jobs.description: As a member of the ML/AI Future Science Platform team, you will work with top CSIRO scientists and engineers to develop new machine learning and artificial intelligence methods with a specific emphasis on solving significant science questions. CSIRO is using digital technologies to help tackle real world challenges from bushfire management to boosting agricultural productivity, from improving cybersecurity to protecting our environments including the Great Barrier Reef. CSIRO offers a range of options for how, when and where you work. Flexible working arrangements can support you in creating balance between your career and personal life, with generous leave conditions and 15.4% superannuation. Applications are open to all including Australian/New Zealand Citizens, Australian Permanent Residents, Australian Temporary Residents, and overseas applicants, with sponsorship potentially provided by CSIRO to eligible candidates if required.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate and Intern EOI – AI & Data Analytics
jobs.description: Komatsu is accepting Expressions of Interest from students eager to join the two-year Graduate Program beginning in 2027, with opportunities for those studying Engineering, Surveying, AI & Data Analytics, Mechatronics or Project Management. The program provides immersive, hands-on training across multiple disciplines, combining technical, business and leadership development to accelerate careers in a fast-evolving industry. For the AI & Data Analytics track, key responsibilities include: leveraging AI, machine learning, and data analytics to improve equipment and site performance; supporting the optimisation of mining, quarry, and construction operations; performing insightful market research to help shape future industry trends; playing a key role in the rollout of new technologies and high-impact projects. The program offers learning on the job while earning a competitive income, full access to Komatsu Employee Benefits including an industry-leading leave policy, and ongoing training, development, and upskilling opportunities.

jobs.title: Quantitative Research Analyst Intern – BS/MS – Australia
jobs.description: The internship is an 11-week program that allows interns to collaborate and connect with senior team members. Opportunities are available in Sydney. The team develops and tests automated quant trading strategies using sophisticated statistical techniques. You will challenge the impossible in quantitative research by applying sophisticated and complex statistical techniques to financial markets. As an intern, you will conceptualize valuation strategies, develop, and continuously improve upon mathematical models and help translate algorithms into code. Requirements: candidates must have a bachelor's or master's degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, or another highly quantitative field, with strong knowledge of probability and statistics (e.g., machine learning, time-series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP), prior experience working in a data-driven research environment, and experience with translating mathematical models and algorithms into code (Python, R or C++).

jobs.title: AI搜索算法工程师（实习）
jobs.description: 小红书社区搜索招聘AI搜索算法实习生，岗位介绍为参与小红书AI搜索相关算法和系统研发，通过最新的生成式AI等技术，打造新一代智能化搜索引擎，工作部门是小红书社区搜索算法团队，工作地点为北京市。工作职责：1. 参与生成式问答答案生成模型优化，包括大模型sft、cot、agent等，有转正机会。

jobs.title: 多模态大模型算法实习生（IEG）
jobs.description: 腾讯IEG-多模态大模型算法实习生：岗位职责包括游戏场景下的多模态大模型算法模型构建，任务包括游戏场景下的图像理解、多模态等领域的多模态大模型能力建设和工程落地。岗位要求：计算机、数学、统计等相关专业研究生及以上学历，或取得读研的本科生；在多模态大模型方面有一定研究基础，熟悉主流多模态大模型和算法；较强的工程实现能力，熟练掌握Python、pytorch；工作地为上海，实习时间6个月以上，长期实习者优先，优秀者可留用。

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生
jobs.description: 职位描述：1、负责快手基座大语言模型优化工作，主要为SFT、RLHF方向的模型训练和优化工作，包括但不限于SFT训练、Reject Sampling、PPO训练，RM训练等；2、跟踪大语言模型方向前沿问题的研究，参与建设并持续保持部门大模型技术在业界的技术先进性，保持创新，实现业界SOTA模型；3、候选人需要有一定的研究和科研背景，鼓励在RLHF方向做出一些原创性工作，同时有发表专利和论文的机会。任职要求：1、对NLP，强化学习，大语言模型等相关领域有一定的理解，在其中一个或多个方向有深入的研究经历；2、优秀的工程实践能力，熟悉Pytorch/Tensorflow等深度学习框架，掌握大规模并行训练技术；3、有大模型训练经验，熟悉Megatron/Deepspeed等常见大模型训练框架；4、实习时长最好在6个月以上。

jobs.title: 算法工程师（具身智能）
jobs.description: 深度参与具身智能（Embodied AI）系统全流程研发工作，聚焦感知、决策、控制三大核心模块；负责机器人系统相关算法的设计、开发与工程实现，重点覆盖视觉感知、运动生成、运动规划与控制等相关方向。任职资格：研究生及以上，机器人、计算机科学与技术、自动化、人工智能等相关专业优先；具备扎实的编程基础，熟练掌握Python或C++中的至少一种编程语言。平安科技（深圳）有限公司是平安集团旗下从事金融科技解决方案提供的核心子公司，专注于为平安集团及外部金融机构提供云计算、人工智能、大数据、区块链等核心技术服务。

jobs.title: 垂搜大模型算法实习生（多模态搜索AI方向）
jobs.description: 快手垂搜大模型团队致力于构建视觉大模型、多模态搜索、User Agent新系统，应用于多种电商场景（如拍照搜同款、图文相似款、电商创意AIGC，买家Agent问答）。实习内容包括：多模态视频图文内容理解、电商多模态信息RAG、AIGC视觉生成、User Agent设计、参与模型蒸馏与量化剪枝等工作，支持生成&翻译算法的性能优化与落地。职位要求：要求计算机、数学、人工智能或相关专业硕士及博士在读，有扎实的机器学习和NLP算法基础；熟悉LLM工程技术和方法并掌握大模型的微调和评估方法；熟悉深度学习框架，如TensorFlow、PyTorch等，有扎实的编程基础和代码实现能力；具备优秀的业务感知以及分析和解决问题的能力，良好的沟通协作能力。

jobs.title: AIGC算法实习生-豆包大模型
jobs.description: The position focuses on exploring and applying multimodal understanding, generative, machine learning, reinforcement learning, AIGC, computer vision, AI and other frontier technologies; exploring large-scale/ultra-large-scale multimodal understanding and generation intertwined foundation models, and conducting extreme system optimization; data construction, instruction fine-tuning, preference alignment, model optimization; exploring breakthroughs in multimodal models, world model advanced capabilities, building universal multimodal Agent for GUI/games and virtual worlds. Job Requirements (任职要求): 2026 undergraduate or above in-service, computer science, electronics, mathematics or related majors preferred; candidates with in-depth research in computer vision, multimodal, AIGC, machine learning, rendering generation or similar fields; excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of deeply solving problems in large model training and applications.

jobs.title: Edge通用智能模型研究实习生（Top Seed Intern）
jobs.description: 加入Seed Edge研究计划，你将探索研究更多内在奖励的机制，从而激发模型主动学习和自我更新的能力；探索构建长期记忆机制，为下一代高效的推理模型、长序列推理及建模提供基础；探索多模态感知能力的边界，研究如何从海量超低信噪比的多模态数据中可扩展地获取知识；探索模型使用工具和基于视觉系统的行动能力，包括全模态Agent基础建模的新方案、以及复杂环境的交互学习能力。任职要求：2026届获得本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、自动化、数学、物理等相关专业。在语言模型、计算机视觉、多模态、AIGC、机器学习等一个或多个领域有较深入的研究者；好奇心驱动，具有出色的分析、解决问题的能力，有自主探索解决方案的能力；具有良好的沟通协作能力，对追求纯粹的技术有强烈热情。

jobs.title: AI工程师（实习生）
jobs.description: AI工程师（实习生）岗位的职责包括：负责AI领域的软件工程化和产品开发；负责AI算法及系统的设计和实现，包括神经网络与机器学习、计算机视觉、无人驾驶、路径规划、智能决策、推荐系统、大模型、生成式AI等；负责产品的集成和调测；负责对外洞察AI领域最新趋势。华为2027届AI实习生专项计划，招聘对象为全球高校在读本科、硕士、博士学生，重点招募具备人工智能相关研究或项目背景的人才，工作地点包括深圳、北京、上海等。

jobs.title: MMU知识图谱中心算法实习生
jobs.description: 快手MMU知识图谱中心招聘算法实习生，该岗位要求计算机相关专业硕士或优秀本科生，有项目经验优先；编码能力强，熟悉数据结构与算法；掌握主流NLP技术与模型算法，有PyTorch/TensorFlow实践经验；有NLP或知识图谱项目经验优先；良好的沟通和团队合作精神；一周4天以上，实习时间3个月以上；工作地在北京/杭州。
